recent.quoted_text: Scottie Barnes & Immanuel Quickley combined to score or assist on 83 of the Raptors' 124 points tonight. CMB tied a season-high with 19 points, Poeltl with his 3 steals. https://t.co/0usnFVMOdZ

recent.text: Luka Garza gotta do the Raptors one more solid
recent.author: Josh Lewenberg
recent.quoted_text: Definitely heard some cheers coming from the Raps room when Garza hit the game-winner for Boston, but RJ Barrett insists they didn't have a preference between Cleveland or New York. He played (and beat) the Cavs in the 4-5 matchup when he was with the Knicks in 2023.

recent.text: Ja'Kobe Walter (right quad contusion) is done for the night.
recent.author: Josh Lewenberg

recent.text: Quickley with his 2nd great floor game in the last 3. Making some great reads tonight, just like he did in Detroit. And always nice to see the 3-ball falling. He's got 16 of his 21 points in the 3rd Q on a perfect 6-6 FG, 3-3 3P. Also ties his season-high with 10 assists.
recent.author: Josh Lewenberg

recent.text: Scottie Barnes has scored 20+ points in each of his 5 games since coming back from the groin injury and 11 of his 13 games this season. He has 22 tonight... at halftime. Also of note: he's shooting 9-for-18 from 3 since the injury. Taking his offensive game to another level.
recent.author: Josh Lewenberg

recent.text: Graves has attempted multiple 3-pointers in 11 straight games and made multiple 3-pointers in 3 straight. He's 7-for-12 from beyond the arc over the last 3 games, including a perfect 3-for-3 tonight (2 from the corner and 1 ATB) 👀
recent.author: Josh Lewenberg
recent.quoted_text: Allen Graves has made a corner-3 in 4 straight games. He's 4-for-7 from the corners over that stretch after starting his career shooting 4-for-17. Encouraging!

recent.text: Raptors lead 31-27, thanks in large part to 10 first-quarter points from Scottie Barnes. The problem: 7 of Brooklyn's 16 shots have come at the rim and they've hit 6 of 'em. They're 8-for-9 in the paint. Way too many blow-bys on D, but Toronto's O has mostly looked good.
recent.author: Josh Lewenberg
Josh Lewenberg
recent.quoted_text: I'd understand using that challenge if Barnes picked up two or three fouls early and you were absolutely sure you were correct. Using it on his FIRST foul 39 seconds into the game is insane enough. Being wrong on such a reckless challenge is inexcusable.
